meaning: k: side of the square window, in px at 1/4 photo resolution (a leaf is ~35 px across), in which the mask share around every pixel is measured. A small window sees a few leaves, a large one a whole part of the plant.

highest mask share f a window may have when it is turned into layers, layers = -ln(1 - min(f, cap)). It limits how many layers a nearly solid window counts: 0.90 = 2.3, 0.99 = 4.6, 0.999 = 6.9 layers.
